title: IMMUFELLOW Postdoctoral Fellowships in Immunology 2027 — University of Turku and Åbo Akademi, Finland

organization.name: IMMUFELLOW — University of Turku / Åbo Akademi University

intro: IMMUFELLOW invites applications for up to 11 fully funded postdoctoral fellowships in immunology research at the University of Turku and Åbo Akademi University, Finland.
description:
Project Overview

IMMUFELLOW is an innovative postdoctoral training initiative of the University of Turku (UTU) and Åbo Akademi University (ÅÅ) in Turku, Finland, jointly funded by the European Union's Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) COFUND programme.

The second call for applications offers up to 11 fixed-term three-year postdoctoral researcher positions for international researchers to conduct immunology-related projects. Nine positions are based at the University of Turku and two at Åbo Akademi University.

Research position overview

Fellows will conduct independently proposed immunology-related research with access to state-of-the-art facilities and interdisciplinary collaboration opportunities. The programme aims to recruit a total of 22 international postdoctoral researchers over two calls during 2025–2030.

Research Areas

  • Basic and translational immunology
  • Inflammation and autoimmune diseases
  • Immuno-oncology and tumour immunology
  • Infectious diseases and host-pathogen interactions
  • Immunometabolism and mucosal immunology

About IMMUFELLOW

IMMUFELLOW is an interdisciplinary and intersectoral research fellowship programme for future leaders in immunology, jointly funded by the University of Turku and Åbo Akademi University through the EU's Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions COFUND programme.
